n = int(input())
strengths = list(map(int, input().split()))
team_assignment = input()

# Calculate the initial strengths for Alice and Bob
alice_strength = sum(strengths[i] for i in range(n) if team_assignment[i] == 'A')
bob_strength = sum(strengths[i] for i in range(n) if team_assignment[i] == 'B')

# Initialize the maximum strength Bob can achieve
max_bob_strength = bob_strength

# Check each prefix and suffix for flipping
for i in range(n):
    # Calculate the strength if Bob flips the prefix ending at i
    flipped_prefix_strength = sum(strengths[j] for j in range(i + 1))
    # Calculate the strength if Bob flips the suffix starting at i
    flipped_suffix_strength = sum(strengths[j] for j in range(i, n))
    
    # Update the maximum strength Bob can achieve
    max_bob_strength = max(max_bob_strength, bob_strength + flipped_prefix_strength - alice_strength, bob_strength + flipped_suffix_strength - alice_strength)

print(max_bob_strength)
